messages.text: Can you make me a drawing of the staggered Si-W layout ?
I’ll use the implemented staggered geometry to draw the alternating layers, silicon coverage and gaps.

The tested layout repeats four tangential/axial phases: **(0,0), (48,0), (0,48), (48,48) mm**. It uses narrow edge boards to preserve the barrel envelope; the short end slabs use a 24 mm axial shift. I’ll show those details alongside a cutaway through the silicon and tungsten layers.

Here’s the tested staggered layout, showing the four layer phases, tungsten/silicon stack, narrow edge boards and endcap packings.

![Staggered Si-W ECAL layout]([redacted]

[Download SVG]([redacted] · [Draft PR #141 with source and reproduction recipe](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/141)

The 48 mm offsets stagger internal module gaps; the full-depth sector seams remain.
